title: Fight Focus: boxing rounds

rounds.title: Short speed combos
rounds.cue: Short and sharp. Reset, then fire again.

rounds.title: Nonstop striking
rounds.cue: Don't stop. Keep the hands moving.

rounds.title: Rear hand strikes
rounds.cue: Turn the hip. Straight back to your guard.

rounds.title: Speed and power hooks
rounds.cue: Fast hooks, then sit down on them.

rounds.title: Nonstop windshield wipers
rounds.cue: Left, right, left, right. Don't stop.

notes: 2026-10-30 owner's montage, cut to ~41s. Voice here is a robot placeholder; on the laptop `npm run voice` uses the app voice (Hazel/Zira). Owner approves before anything posts; TikTok goes out as Only me first.

2026-10-30 v3: owner's second cut with typed round labels. Labels are reference only; the focus card hides them (card.y / card.spans per round). Voice is still the cloud placeholder until `npm run voice` on the laptop.

2026-10-30 v4 (owner): no RUSH screens; no box behind the focus text, which moves low; ROUND n stays in the centre; dim only on the 3-2-1, rounds snap in. With no box to hide the typed labels, rounds are cut around them (~32 s). Text-free exports from InShot would give back the labelled stretches (incl. the close-up flurry).

2026-10-31 v5 (owner): lead hand round out (too short); RUSH back on the windshield wipers only, with a snap close-up; the round ends when the owner stops (clock 0:00, final bell, freeze on them catching their breath) and goes to STAGE CLEAR before they walk off; push-ins and snap close-ups through every round.
2026-10-31 owner's round order: speed combos, nonstop striking, rear hand, power hooks, windshield wipers last.

2026-10-31: owner wants an arcade announcer voice (Higgsfield) instead of the robotic placeholder. 8 auditions made (brain/voices.md); waiting on the owner to pick one. Finale starts 0.8 s earlier so the call finishes before Rush mode!; the last call reads FINAL ROUND.
